To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) topic quality is best evaluated with a combination of topic coherence metrics, (ii) topic model quality is best evaluated by comparing the topic model with other topic models, (iii) topic coherence is best evaluated with the topic coherence metric UCI, (iv) topic model quality can be evaluated by comparing the model to other models using a combination of coherence metrics and topic model quality metrics, and (v) topic coherence is a better indicator of human judgment of topic quality than topic model quality metrics

1) for single topic evaluation, topic coherence is a good measure of the quality of topics, and the topic coherence measure can be improved by adding a measure of topic novelty, and 2) for whole topic model evaluation, the best evaluation method is to use the topic coherence measure to evaluate each individual topic in a topic model.

(1) the coherence metric, which is based on the probability of a random word appearing in a topic, is the best single topic quality measure, (2) the coherence metric is also the best single topic model quality measure, and (3) the coherence metric can be used to select a good number of topics to use for a particular topic model.

the following three tasks: (a) evaluating the coherence of a single topic, (b) evaluating the coherence and diversity of a topic model, and (c) evaluating the quality of a topic model.
two main tasks: (i) automatically evaluating the coherence of single topics, and (ii) automatically evaluating the overall quality of a topic model.
two tasks: (1) automatic evaluation of single topic models; and (2) automatic evaluation of whole sets of topics (i.e., topic models).

the most accurate way to evaluate the quality of a topic is to use the topic to predict the topic of a new document, and that the best way to evaluate the overall quality of a topic model is to use the topics to predict the topics of new documents.

topic models can be automatically evaluated by using a variety of methods, but the most effective methods are those that use human judgments as ground truth.
topic models are a good way to summarize documents and that topic model quality is best evaluated using topic coherence, but that topic coherence is not the best method to evaluate single topics.

automatic evaluation of topic models is a difficult problem, but that the best approach to this problem is to evaluate topics individually, rather than trying to evaluate topic models as a whole.
